name: What kind of caulk should be used in bathrooms and kitchens to prevent mold?

mainEntity.name: What kind of caulk should be used in bathrooms and kitchens to prevent mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms and kitchens, where high humidity and moisture are prevalent, using caulk with mildewcide or mold-resistant properties is crucial. 100% silicone caulk is highly recommended as it provides superior water resistance, flexibility, and longevity, resisting mold and mildew growth effectively. Siliconeized acrylic latex caulk is another good option, offering easier cleanup and paintability, though typically less durable in highly wet areas than pure silicone. Always ensure the caulk specifies mold or mildew resistance on its label.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use 100% silicone caulk or siliconeized acrylic latex with mildewcide in bathrooms and kitchens for mold resistance and superior waterproofing.
